resolution_note: All 9 P0 issues fixed in LayerZero cross-chain module refactor. See fix mapping below.

p0_resolution_log.title: CreditManager _lzReceive payload parsing mismatch
p0_resolution_log.fix: Replaced abi.encode(MSG_SEND_CREDIT, amount) with MessageCodec.encodeCreditUpdate(amount) [encodePacked(type, abi.encode(data))]. Receiver uses MessageCodec.decodeMsgType + decodeAmount [payload[0] + abi.decode(payload[1:])].
p0_resolution_log.verified: forge build passes, encoding/decoding consistency verified by subagent

p0_resolution_log.title: CrossChainAssetController _lzReceive payload parsing mismatch
p0_resolution_log.fix: Receiver changed from abi.decode(_payload, (bytes1, uint256)) to MessageCodec.decodeMsgType(_payload) + MessageCodec.decodeAmount(_payload) [abi.decode(payload[1:], (uint256))]. Senders (RemoteAssetAdapter) now use MessageCodec.encodeWithdrawConfirm/encodeYieldReport.
p0_resolution_log.verified: forge build passes, encoding/decoding consistency verified

p0_resolution_log.title: Silent failure: withdraw confirmation silently dropped
p0_resolution_log.fix: Replaced `if (address(this).balance >= fee.nativeFee)` conditional send with `if (address(this).balance < fee.nativeFee) revert InsufficientGasBalance(...)`. Transaction now reverts instead of silently dropping.

p0_resolution_log.title: Silent failure: yield report silently dropped
p0_resolution_log.fix: Same pattern as ERR-001. _sendYieldReport now reverts on insufficient gas balance.

p0_resolution_log.title: Placeholder _calculateYield returning 0
p0_resolution_log.fix: Changed from `return 0` with placeholder comment to `virtual` function that `revert LayerZeroErrors.NotImplemented('_calculateYield')`. No placeholder comments remain.

p0_resolution_log.title: RemoteAssetAdapter silently drops cross-chain confirmation
p0_resolution_log.fix: Duplicate of ERR-001. Both _sendWithdrawConfirmation and _sendYieldReport now revert on insufficient gas.

p0_resolution_log.title: MSG_MINT_SHARES silently ignores invalid receiver or zero shares
p0_resolution_log.fix: Changed from `if (receiver != address(0) && shares > 0) { pptOft.mint(...) }` to explicit revert: `if (receiver == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress(); if (shares == 0) revert InvalidAmount(); pptOft.mint(receiver, shares);`

p0_resolution_log.title: PPTOFTAdapter approve then safeTransfer creating dangling allowance
p0_resolution_log.fix: Removed `innerToken.approve(redemptionManager, shares)` from _handleRedemption. _requestRedemption is now virtual+revert stub (subclass decides push vs pull pattern). Also removed the keccak256-based fake requestId.

p0_resolution_log.title: CrossChainAssetController optimistic accounting creates unrecoverable state
p0_resolution_log.fix: Added `pendingDeploys` and `pendingWithdraws` mappings. withdrawFromRemote now records to pendingWithdraws and only decrements _protocolAllocations. deployedAssets and totalDeployed are decremented when MSG_WITHDRAW_CONFIRM is received in _lzReceive.

positive_observations: All 9 P0 critical issues resolved in single refactor
MessageCodec.sol provides single source of truth for all 11 message types
LzOptionsLib.sol correctly encodes Type 3 options with worker ID and option type headers
All sender/receiver encoding pairs verified consistent by automated analysis
Virtual stubs with revert ensure protocol integration points fail explicitly
forge build: 0 errors, all existing tests pass
